finding: World-readable /etc/shadow disclosed via LFI (all accounts locked, but file structure leaked)
target: Debian container base image / GENESIS demo:8080
remediation: Constrain /download to its FILES_DIR with resolve+relative_to (already present in PATCHED mode).

finding: Unauthenticated JWT Issuance — /auth/demo-token Mints Admin Tokens for Anonymous Callers
target: FastAPI 0.115.6 / GENESIS CISO Demo Range v1.0.0 (BOTH 10.10.0.11 vulnerable and 10.10.0.10 patched):8080
remediation: (1) Delete /auth/demo-token in production. (2) Require credentials at /auth/login and never trust client-supplied role; resolve role from the authenticated user record server-side. (3) Add per-IP rate limiting + audit log on token issuance.

finding: JWT Verifier Ignores 'alg' Header — Algorithm-Confusion Across All Schemes
target: FastAPI 0.115.6 / GENESIS CISO Demo Range v1.0.0 (10.10.0.11:8080, vulnerable mode)
remediation: Enforce an explicit allowlist for the alg header before signature verification (alg == 'HS256' only; reject 'none', missing, empty, and every other value). The patched twin's verifier already does this — port the same check to the vulnerable build.

finding: LFI exposes /etc/shadow + /proc/self/environ + /proc/net/tcp (full container introspection)
remediation: Resolve + reject paths outside FILES_DIR; drop container root.

finding: LFI exposes /etc/shadow + /proc/self/environ + /proc/net/tcp (full container introspection)
remediation: Resolve + reject paths outside FILES_DIR; drop container root.

finding: SSRF-as-port-scan: /api/fetch enables discovery of internal docker services (172.20.0.0/24)
remediation: Filter SSRF targets and avoid leaking backend error strings.

finding: Container process runs as Uid:0 (root) with DAC_OVERRIDE — privilege amplifier for all RCE/LFI primitives
target: GENESIS CISO Demo Range v1.0.0 (uvicorn) on Docker container e05814d7d55f
remediation: Drop root in the container: add `USER appuser` to the Dockerfile and `cap_drop: [ALL]` + `no-new-privileges: true` in compose.

finding: Container runs as root (Uid:0) — escalates every other web vuln to container-root
target: GENESIS CISO Demo Range FastAPI 1.0.0 deployment:8080
remediation: Run uvicorn as non-root inside the container; drop all linux capabilities.

finding: Source code disclosure also present on patched twin (no mode gating on /demo-artifacts route)
remediation: Gate or remove source-disclosure endpoints in any non-demo deployment.

finding: Patched twin retains unauthenticated admin JWT minting endpoint /auth/demo-token
remediation: Remove anonymous token-mint endpoint; require real authentication for /auth/login.

finding: Patched-twin SSRF blocklist bypass via hostname normalization (trailing dot, decimal/octal/hex IPs, '0' shorthand)
remediation: Resolve DNS server-side, normalise host (strip trailing dot, lowercase), then test against an IP-based deny-list — never a string deny-list.

finding: Forged JWT Chains into IDOR — Read Any Account via /api/accounts/{id}
target: FastAPI 0.115.6 / GENESIS CISO Demo Range v1.0.0
remediation: Enforce owner == token.sub (or role == admin) on every account lookup — patched branch already does this and must always run.

finding: Verbose SQL Error / Internal Query Disclosure in /api/search response
remediation: Never echo internal SQL or stack traces to clients.

finding: Full Source Code Disclosure at /demo-artifacts/source/app/main.py
remediation: Strip source-disclosure endpoints from production builds.

finding: Path Traversal / Arbitrary File Read via /download?file=
remediation: Resolve + relative_to or use a whitelist of known files.

finding: Stored XSS in /notes (raw HTML rendering)
remediation: html.escape before insertion; consider CSP.

finding: Stored XSS in /notes (raw HTML rendering)
remediation: html.escape before insertion; consider CSP.

finding: Reflected XSS in /feedback message parameter
remediation: Always html.escape user input before embedding into HTML.

finding: IDOR on /api/accounts/{id} — viewer can read any account
remediation: Enforce ownership check in all environments, not just patched mode.

finding: JWT Lacks Expiry / Issued-At / Not-Before Claims — Tokens Are Immortal
target: FastAPI 0.115.6 / GENESIS CISO Demo Range v1.0.0 (both 10.10.0.11 vulnerable and 10.10.0.10 patched):8080
remediation: Set exp (≤15 min), iat, jti claims on issuance and reject tokens missing/exceeding exp on verification. Maintain a jti blocklist for revoked tokens.

finding: Patched-Mode JWT Secret Disclosed via Public Source-Code Endpoint
target: FastAPI 0.115.6 / GENESIS CISO Demo Range v1.0.0 (DEMO_MODE=patched, 10.10.0.10:8080)
remediation: Delete the /demo-artifacts/source/app/main.py route in production builds and load JWT_SECRET from an environment variable or secret manager — never from source.

finding: Server-Side Request Forgery on /api/fetch — leaks fake cloud metadata
remediation: Apply allow-list of egress hosts; resolve DNS server-side and block private/loopback/link-local.

finding: Unauthenticated admin JWT minting via /auth/demo-token
remediation: Delete /auth/demo-token in production builds; gate token issuance behind real authentication.

finding: Hardcoded HS256 JWT secret "demo" enables token forgery
remediation: Load a high-entropy secret from environment/secret manager; rotate.

finding: JWT alg=none signature bypass on /api/admin/metrics
remediation: Reject alg!='HS256' (or use a vetted library like PyJWT with required_algorithms).

finding: OS Command Injection in /api/diagnostics/ping (shell=True with unfiltered host)
remediation: Validate host against a strict whitelist and pass argv list with shell=False.

finding: SQL Injection in /api/search q parameter (f-string concatenation into sqlite query)
remediation: Use parameterised queries (the patched branch already shows the fix).

finding: POST /auth/login Accepts Arbitrary Role with No Authentication
target: FastAPI 0.115.6 — login() handler with LoginIn pydantic model:8080
remediation: Require password (or other credential) verification; derive role from the user record, never from the request body.

finding: JWT Has No exp/iat/nbf Claims — Tokens Are Effectively Eternal
remediation: Issue short-lived tokens (≤15 min) with iat/exp/nbf and enforce exp on every verify; add a revocation list keyed by jti.

finding: Public Admin Token Issuance — /auth/demo-token Mints Privileged JWTs Unauthenticated
remediation: Remove or hard-disable the demo token issuer outside ephemeral dev environments.

finding: JWT Weak HMAC Secret 'demo' — Token Forgery via Brute Force
remediation: Use a high-entropy random 256-bit secret from a secrets manager; never commit secrets to source.

finding: Stored XSS in /notes (note text rendered unescaped to all viewers)
remediation: Validate the affected code/configuration and remove the vulnerable behavior.

target: FastAPI 0.115.6 GENESIS CISO Demo Range v1.0.0 — custom JWT verifier in app/main.py:8080
remediation: Reject any alg other than the expected HS256/RS256; never return payload before signature verification.
